2. `liongard_launchpoint LIST` for the environment with inspector ID 45. One report section per system found; if none, say so and stop. Record `latestInspectionDate` for each.
3. This card continues in 2 more files. Before fetching anything, run one knowledge search for each of these exact phrases and read every result: "single-system-autotask run card part 2"; "single-system-autotask run card part 3". If you run out of searches before every part is read, do not skip those metrics and do not stop silently: evaluate the parts you have, list the unread parts, and end the turn with "Reply continue to evaluate the remaining parts." When the user replies continue, search only the unread parts, evaluate them, and give the complete report. Then confirm you can see all 7 metric lines (P001 to P007). Retrieval returns only part of this card: if any sequence id is missing, search the knowledge again for the heading of the missing group (for example "single-system-autotask metrics P013-P018") until every line is found. Never skip a metric because its line was not retrieved.
4. For every metric line below, call `liongard_metric EVALUATE` with `metricId`, `systemId`, `environmentId`: this returns the value Liongard already stored, so write no query. If that call returns no data rows at all (the metric is not stored on this instance) or has no metricId, do not retry the stored call: immediately call `liongard_metric EVALUATE` once with `jmesPathQuery` set to that line's fallback query exactly as written on that metric's own `fallback query` line. Operator words in fallback queries: knowledge storage corrupts the symbols, so before sending, replace each EQ_OP with two equals characters in a row and each AND_OP with two ampersand characters in a row and each OR_OP with two vertical-bar characters in a row, changing nothing else. An empty array, an empty string or 0 is a real value, not "No data": report it as such. Only a null, an error, or no rows after the fallback is "No data".
5. Run exactly these metric lines: no extra metrics, no `liongard_metric LIST`, no invented paths or sequence numbers.
6. Write the report in the report format below, apply the QA and rendering rules from the agent instructions, and end with Manual Verification Needed.

## 3. Metrics to fetch

7 metrics. Each line has its stored metricId and its own fallback query.

The metric lines are in `single-system-autotask run card part 2`, `single-system-autotask run card part 3`. Search for each part by name and run every line.

## 4. Report

Sections, in order: Executive Summary; Ticket Volume & Trend; Ticket Aging; SLA Compliance; Resource Utilization; Time Entry & Billing; Contract Audit; Per-Customer Ticket Profile; Recommended Actions; Data Gaps & Coverage Notes.

Thresholds: ticket_age_warn_days=7; ticket_age_critical_days=30; sla_compliance_pct_min=95; resource_billable_utilization_target_pct=70; time_entry_lag_days_max=2; contract_expiration_warn_days=60; contract_without_resource_max=0.

Report each metric's actual value. Show "No data" for empty values; never mark a control passing without a supporting value. A "No data" row is a coverage gap only if the control matters and no other row covers it.

Coverage table: metrics fetched / required, with data / no data counts. Internal audience: add a verification log, one row per call (seq, metricId, result shape, status).

### Insights and recommendations

| Pattern | Recommendation template |
|---|---|
| Empty or stale Autotask dataprint | "Autotask launchpoint is not producing current data. Fix inspection status before using PSA metrics in reporting." |
| Company/account inventory available | "Autotask contains <N> active companies/accounts. Use this as the MCP-backed tenant inventory baseline." |
| Inactive company/account count above zero | "Autotask contains <N> inactive companies/accounts. Confirm whether inactive records should be excluded from reporting and billing workflows." |
| Primary contact coverage | "Autotask contains <N> primary contacts. Validate primary-contact coverage in the Autotask console before client communication workflows rely on it." |
| Operational PSA metrics requested | "Ticket, SLA, resource, time-entry, contract, and project metrics are not present in the validated Liongard Autotask dataprint. Attach Autotask console reports for those sections." |
